title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The flats by moon
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The third card, February: two dogs, a crab, a moon. He redraws it as the flats at night — he has drawn this before, in a motel on the sabbatical, and doesn't remember — with the old dog, thirteen, and a second dog that isn't there, and the crab from the flyer climbing from a channel. The card names the thing twice.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: mudflats at night under a full moon with an old dog and a second dog's outline, a crab climbing from a channel between them, two dock pilings for towers. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
